rights.title: Rights
rights.description: Licences and release terms for your assets: where and until when they can be used, and whether they must carry a watermark.
rights.loadFailed: We could not load the rights
rights.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to rights
forbidden.description: Managing rights needs the rights permission. Ask an administrator if you need it.

empty.title: No rights yet
empty.description: A rights record describes a licence: who it comes from, which channels and regions it covers, when it is valid and whether previews must be watermarked. Assign one to an asset and Orbit enforces it when the asset is published or delivered.

noMatch.title: No rights match
noMatch.description: Try a different search or status.

rights.pending_one: {{count}} assigned asset is still being updated in the background.
rights.pending_other: {{count}} assigned assets are still being updated in the background; they follow within the hour.

delete.title: Delete these rights?
delete.body: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.documents_one: Its {{count}} document is deleted with it.
delete.documents_other: Its {{count}} documents are deleted with it.
delete.inUse_one: Still assigned to {{count}} asset. Reassign it first.
delete.inUse_other: Still assigned to {{count}} assets. Reassign them first.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: You have unsaved changes to these rights. If you close now they are lost.

form.name: Name
form.whereLead: Leave a list empty to allow every channel or region. Changing these lists changes who can find the assets that use this licence.
form.narrowing_one: This narrows where the licence applies. It is assigned to {{count}} asset, and any of them left with no allowed channel or region disappears for restricted consumers such as signage players and dealers.
form.narrowing_other: This narrows where the licence applies. It is assigned to {{count}} assets, and any of them left with no allowed channel or region disappear for restricted consumers such as signage players and dealers.
form.validToHint: The last day the licence is valid, inclusive.
form.datesBackwards: The end date cannot be before the start date.
form.watermarkHint: Previews are always watermarked; the original and video are withheld.
form.saveFailed: The rights could not be saved. Try again.

channel.label: Allowed channels
channel.freeEntry: Type a code and press Enter; letters, digits, - and _ only.

region.label: Allowed regions
region.freeEntry: Type a code and press Enter; letters, digits, - and _ only.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lead: Release forms and licence files. They are saved as soon as they upload, without pressing Save.
documents.saveFirst: Save the rights first, then you can attach release forms and licence files.
documents.loadFailed: We could not load the documents.
documents.downloadFailed: Could not create the download link
documents.deleteBody: “{{name}}” is removed from storage and cannot be recovered.
documents.rules: PDF, PNG, JPEG, DOCX or TXT, up to {{max}} each. The file extension must match the type.
documents.notScanned: Documents are not virus-scanned. Only upload files you trust.

problem.type: {{name}}: only PDF, PNG, JPEG, DOCX and TXT files are accepted.
problem.mismatch: {{name}}: the file extension does not match the file type.
